rule: Reuse existing identifiers and schema where available. Do not introduce incompatible replacements. New logical names below are aliases onto existing production fields unless marked NEW_CORPUS_ONLY.

mapsTo.notes: CIK is the public SEC issuer key; store alongside Company, never replace Company.id

identities.notes: No first-class Filing Prisma model today. WS-CKF must publish corpus filing records keyed by accession + CIK before dependents persist filing_id as a FK.
Bytes identity is contentHash (sha256). Document.id is the product document row once promoted.

mapsTo.path: Document.id + Document.effectiveFrom/effectiveTo + contentHash of stored bytes

identities.notes: No separate DocumentVersion table. Version identity is document row + effective dating + content hash. Restatement/supersession uses Document.supersedesDocumentId / DocumentRelationshipEdge.

mapsTo.path: discovery candidate keys in contract-model discovery outputs

identities.notes: Corpus agents may publish importable candidate records with stable content identities before DB promotion; must carry source spans + status, never silent permission invent.
WS-CDA atlas edges are corpus overlays until mapped onto these production edge tables; do not invent a second production dependency resolver.
No production precedent-pattern table. WS-PCI publishes corpus-only pattern IDs with source provenance; never label as reviewed precedent without human verification_record.
Corpus hypotheses are NOT semantic_representation_id until they clear verification gates. Do not write Phase-3 IR from corpus agents.
Source-only and model-hypothesis records must carry verificationStatus != VERIFIED/APPROVED.

antiPatterns: Creating parallel Document/DocumentNode tables for the same bytes
Promoting model hypotheses to semantic_representation_id without verification_record_id
Asserting operative authority from superseded text
Counting duplicate agreements as distinct instruments without contentHash/filing reconciliation
